title: Container image input
description: An OCI image pinned by an immutable tag and its manifest digest.

tag.description: An optional leading v then a digit, which rejects floating tags such as latest, stable, beta, java21 and java25. The one exception is dev-proton, the only tag under which mornedhels/enshrouded-server ships a Proton that can start Enshrouded 1.0; the digest still pins the bytes.
